title: Spicy Korean Beef Noodles
description: A flavorful and spicy dish made with Korean-inspired beef and noodles. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil to the pan.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Gochujang sauce and soy sauce to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Return the beef to the pan and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
